checks: Fresh Start through nine lifestyle choices, all 60 official items, 15 broad-work items, priorities, education and 11 profession prompts
Pause, reload and resume after question 40 without repeating an introduction
Correct priorities and education transitions; main route omitted experience and extra work style
Optional experience introduction, one saved answer, pause/resume on the second question, Back verifies the selected first answer
Save and return exits optional review without requiring remaining optional questions
Six scores unchanged after optional review
Named program saved on career page and retained after reload and creation of My Plan
Published residency label appears at top of plan
Saved program card fits at 390px and 320px without horizontal overflow
New frozen food model opens in Developer expanded view; change one official answer and rerun pathways, careers and plan
Reset restores original six scores and outputs; experiment has no console errors

scope: Scenario consistency, source checks, software regression and one observed complete phone-sized UI journey. Not a psychometric validation study, representative usability study, measured completion time or success probability.
